videos.description: 📍 Bebra – Railway Heart of Hesse 🚂✨ Bebra, a small town in northern Hesse, once stood as one of Germany’s 🇩🇪 most important railway junctions. In the 19th and 20th century, trains from east and west crossed here, making it a true gateway between regions. 🚆 During the Cold War, Bebra even became a border station, where East and West German trains met. Today, surrounded by green forests and gentle hills 🌳⛰️, the town keeps its railway heritage alive, blending history with quiet countryside charm. 🌿 #Bebra #Hessen #germany #berlin #europe
